evals.prompt: Prepare store-release for version 2.0. The last tagged release is v1.9. Write App Store and Play Store version notes from the user-visible changes, update docs/store if those files exist, and sync Android/iOS version fields to 2.0.
evals.expected_output: Asks for nothing extra if 2.0 is already in the prompt. Uses v1.9 as the base. Version notes are source-verified, unlabeled customer sentences, equivalent across locales and stores, with Play notes at or under 500 characters. Public versions are 2.0. No tag, commit, upload, or publish.
expectations: The target public version is 2.0 and was not inferred from tags or config
Version notes cite user-visible behavior verified in production source
Play Store version notes stay within 500 characters
The run does not create, fetch, push, or modify git tags

evals.prompt: Write Play Store listing content for my Android app. I need the title, short description, full description, and What's New.
evals.expected_output: Asks exactly one blocking question for the public version and makes no edits until that version is given.
expectations: The assistant asks which public version to prepare
No store documents or version files are edited before the version is given

evals.prompt: I need App Store What's New for 1.4 compared with 1.3. This is an iOS-only app and there are no docs/store files.
evals.expected_output: Paste-ready App Store version notes only, in fenced text fields, for detected locales. No Play Store copy. No version-file edits if none exist. Claims are user-facing and not labeled Feature/Fix/Improvement.
expectations: Output includes App Store version notes for 1.4
Output does not include Play Store fields
Version notes do not use Feature:, Fix:, or Improvement: labels
